    1. itemPath(Player)

Interface ItemContents

public interface ItemContents
A container that shows one item's contents, such as a shulker box opened from the player's inventory, and says where that item is. Container slot i is index i inside the item, so ItemSources.pathOf(Player, Slot) names the slot as itemPath(player).child(i): "slot 3 of the box at inventory slot 14". 
class OpenedBox extends StorageContainerAdapter implements ItemContents {
    public @Nullable ItemPath itemPath(Player p) { return p == opener && !live.isStale() ? live.path() : null; }
}
Implement it on the container behind the screen's slots, on whichever side knows the path (usually only the server's). Since 2.3.0.

      @Nullable ItemPath itemPath(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player)
      Where the item is, as player names it, or null when that player can't name it (another player's inventory) or the item is gone. Read on each call, so a container that follows its item to a new place answers with the new path.
